test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who is the ex-officio Chairman of the Council of States as per the Constitution of India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** The Vice President.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 63** of the Indian Constitution tells that there shall be a **Vice-President of India.** 
 
• **Articles 64 and 89 (1)** tell that the** Vice-President** **of India shall be the ex-officio Chairman of the Council of States(Rajya Sabha)**.
 
• In the constitutional setup of India, the holder of the office of the Vice president is part of the** executive but as the chairman of the Rajya Sabha**, he is a part of Parliament. He has thus a dual capacity and holds two distinct and separate offices.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Governor is the ex - officio Chairman of the state Legislative Council (Vidhan Parishad).**
 
• **The Prime Minister of India is the ex-officio chairman of the NITI Aayog.** NITI Aayog is an executive body, that was initiated by the Indian government in **2015.**
 
• The executive power of the State shall be vested in the Governor and shall be exercised by him either directly or through officers subordinate to him in accordance with the Constitution of India** (Article 154).**
 
• **Article 53**, the executive power of the country is vested in the president and is exercised by the president either directly or through officers subordinate to him in accordance with the constitution.
 
• **Article 78(1)** states that **it is the Prime Minister's job to keep the President up to date on the decisions made by the Council of Ministers in relation to administrative concerns and legislative proposals.**
